title: Finite colimit filtration with compatible graded colimit isomorphisms
statement: Let I be a small directed preordered set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], possibly empty, and A:I→Ab a functor. Give A_i decreasing filtrations F_i [def-sp-filtration] and filtered maps a_f lifting A(f). Suppose common integers L,U satisfy F_i^q=A_i for q≤L and F_i^q=0 for q>U. There exist a finite decreasing filtration H on colim A and filtered cocone maps c_i:A_i→colim A whose underlying maps are the colimit legs. For every q, every functor Q:I→Ab and isomorphisms e_i:Q_i≅gr^q F_i commuting with Q(f) and gr^q a_f [lem-sp-finite-filtration-induction], there is an isomorphism θ:colim Q→gr^q H with θ∘ι_i=gr^q(c_i)∘e_i. Moreover, for any filtered object (B,G), compatible filtered maps b_i:(A_i,F_i)→(B,G), and underlying map φ:colim A→B satisfying the cocone equations, there is a filtered map f:(colim A,H)→(B,G) with underlying map φ and f∘c_i=b_i.

proof.text: Uniqueness of restriction through monic inclusions gives diagrams of q-th filtration steps and their consecutive inclusions. Exactness of directed colimits makes colim F_i^q→colim A_i monic. Its subobject defines H^q, and the consecutive inclusions make H decreasing. The bounds give H^L=colim A and H^{U+1}=0. The canonical cocone legs are filtered maps c_i.

source.place: Tag 0EZM (lemma-colimit-variant-complexes), proof, finite-term spectral-sequence comparison; detailed exactness input Tag 00DB and filtration induction Tag 0127

proof.text: Take colimits of the short exact sequences 0→F_i^{q+1}→F_i^q→gr^q F_i→0. Exactness identifies the colimit of graded pieces with gr^q H. The compatible e_i identify the diagram Q with the graded diagram. Composing the induced colimit isomorphisms gives θ, with the stated cocone equations by the cokernel universal property and the definition of gradedMap.

source.place: Tag 0EZM (lemma-colimit-variant-complexes), proof, finite-term spectral-sequence comparison; detailed exactness input Tag 00DB and filtration induction Tag 0127

proof.text: The restrictions of a compatible filtered cocone b induce maps colim F_i^q→G^q. Their commutation with the inclusions shows that φ is filtered. Equality of underlying maps, together with proof irrelevance, gives f∘c_i=b_i. For empty I all colimits are zero and the zero filtration gives all conclusions. If U<L the bounds force all A_i=0 and the same zero construction applies.

theorem finite_filtered_colimit_model
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (A : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (F : ∀ i : I, DecreasingFiltration (A.obj i))
    (a : ∀ {i j : I} (_ : i ⟶ j),
      (⟨A.obj i, F i⟩ : FilteredObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶ ⟨A.obj j, F j⟩)
    (ha : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), (a f).hom = A.map f)
    (L U : ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ (i : I) (q : ℤ),
      (q ≤ L → (F i).step q = ⊤) ∧ (U < q → (F i).step q = ⊥)) :
    ∃ (H : DecreasingFiltration (colimit A))
      (c : ∀ i : I, (⟨A.obj i, F i⟩ : FilteredObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶
        ⟨colimit A, H⟩),
      (∀ i : I, (c i).hom = colimit.ι A i) ∧ H.IsFinite ∧
      (∀ (q : ℤ) (Q : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (e : ∀ i : I, Q.obj i ≅ (F i).gradedPiece q),
        (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
          Q.map f ≫ (e j).hom = (e i).hom ≫ FilteredObject.gradedMap (a f) q) →
        ∃ θ : colimit Q ⟶ H.gradedPiece q,
          (∀ i : I, colimit.ι Q i ≫ θ = (e i).hom ≫
            FilteredObject.gradedMap (c i) q) ∧ IsIso θ) ∧
      (∀ (B : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (G : DecreasingFiltration B)
        (b : ∀ i : I,
          (⟨A.obj i, F i⟩ : FilteredObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶ ⟨B, G⟩),
        (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), A.map f ≫ (b j).hom = (b i).hom) →
        ∀ φ : colimit A ⟶ B,
          (∀ i : I, colimit.ι A i ≫ φ = (b i).hom) →
          ∃ f : (⟨colimit A, H⟩ : FilteredObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⟶ ⟨B, G⟩,
            f.hom = φ ∧ ∀ i : I, c i ≫ f = b i)
